title: VTA Passkey-VM List — payload
description: List every passkey verificationMethod currently published on a VTA-managed DID. Admin-gated read. The returned entries are the same Multikey verificationMethods that appear in the DID document.

did.description: The DID whose passkey verificationMethods to enumerate. The producer MUST hold the admin role on this DID's context.

Response.title: VTA Passkey-VM List — response payload
Response.description: The passkey verificationMethods currently on the DID.

verificationMethods.description: Every passkey verificationMethod published on the DID. Empty when none are enrolled.
